title: Pilindavaccha
html:
• Theragāthā 1.9 Verses of the Senior Monks 1.9
  • Ekakanipāta The Book of the Ones
  • Paṭhamavagga Chapter One

Pilindavacchattheragāthā Pilindavaccha

“Svāgataṁ na durāgataṁ, It was welcome, not unwelcome, Nayidaṁ dumantitaṁ mama; the advice I got was good. Saṁvibhattesu dhammesu, Of the well-explained teachings, Yaṁ seṭṭhaṁ tadupāgamin”ti. I arrived at the best.

Itthaṁ sudaṁ āyasmā pilindavaccho thero gāthaṁ abhāsitthāti. That is how this verse was recited by the senior venerable Pilindavaccha.
